jobs.title: Air Quality Consultant
jobs.description:
Description - External

Role: Air Quality Consultant (G2/G3)

Location: Edinburgh, Newcastle, Leeds, York, Sheffield, Birmingham or London.

Arup is a global leader in design, planning, engineering, and consulting. Our diverse team of experts collaborates on award winning and innovative projects across various markets, offering you the chance to work on exciting and impactful initiatives worldwide. Through our work, we are continuously striving to Shape a Better World.
Due to ever an increasing pipeline of work, we are looking for a recent graduate to start or further their career in environmental consultancy and join our UK air quality team. The successful candidate can be based in one of our offices where we already have a wider air quality team presence, namely: Edinburgh, Newcastle, Leeds, York, Sheffield, Birmingham or London.
Role

You will have the opportunity to work on diverse projects among different sectors including energy, aviation, infrastructure and advisory. On a daily basis, you will work alongside our experienced consultants and undertake air quality assessments, from informing design to fulfilling regulatory requirements and accompanying planning applications. You will provide a key role supporting and assisting with all aspects in project delivery, as well as communicating and liaising with clients (internal and external) regularly. Subject to project requirements, attendance at site visits is also to be expected.

Essential qualifications and experience

A Bachelors or Masters degree in a relevant subject
Strong interest and knowledge of air quality and environmental matters
Strong problem-solving initiatives
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Highly motivated and a team player
Strong organisational skills and able to work to deadlines.

Desirable experience

Experience in delivering air quality assessments and the use of dispersion modelling software such as ADMS, AERMOD
Proficient in geographical information system (GIS)
Experience in digital tools such as PowerBI, OpenAir and Python for data interpretation and visualisation

Member of the Institute of Air Quality Management (IAQM) or Institution of Environmental Science (IES)

Show more

Show less

Seniority level

Mid-Senior level

Employment type

Full-time

Industries

Business Consulting and Services, Environmental Services, and Engineering Services
